annotations.text:
All five onboarding screens, left to right in the order they appear.

S3 is the only one with no Skip. Everything after it depends on the reader having seen what PAWER cannot do.

Shapes drift, bob and turn behind the text. Onboarding is the one place a loop is allowed, since it is seen once, and everything stops for reduced motion.

Copy is the real onboarding text, retuned for no em dashes and no prose colons.

S1 lost its em dash. S4 lost one too. S5's "Two things left:" became "Two things left."

The name on S4 is optional and never leaves the phone, which is why the field has no required marker.

Real screens, rebuilt from the app's own tokens.

Edit anything. Drag, retype, restyle in the properties panel. Save keeps your version.

Then tell Claude Code what changed.

TYPE

Getai Grotesk Black on display 40, title 24, and the logo. It has no · › ✓ ✗ glyphs, so it stays on the big text.

Aspekta everywhere else. Headline 18/700, body 15/400, label 13/500, caption 11/400.

SYSTEM

ground #F5F5F5 · ink #212431 · slate #4F5D75 · accent #EA5C1F · notice #DDE0E6
status clear #9BF06B · upcoming #FF90E8 · ongoing #FF5C5C · ended #FFD93D

border 2px · shadow 4px hard · radius 5

Everything except the target and the message dims by 32%. Not a blackout, just a recede, so you can still see what you are being shown in context.

The dim is four rectangles around the target, so the highlighted control keeps its real colours and stays tappable. The message is drawn above the dim and never darkens.

IN THE APP ALREADY
Fonts, slide transitions, drawn glyphs.

STILL ONLY HERE
Radius 5, the checkerboard, the shorter copy, the removed disclaimer lines, list fades, shapes, the lighter tour dim and the new tour wording.
